_comment: Curated half of the store catalog — the part a human owns. The machine half (name, size, fw tag, fap path) is filled in by tools/make_catalog.py at build time; see store/catalog.json (generated, do not edit).
_adding_an_app: Add an entry here, then make sure it BUILDS (CI proves that) and RUNS on a real device (only you can prove that). dir = folder under applications_user/, id = appid from its application.fam.

apps.author: Lewis Westbury / port
apps.description: Resistor color-code / VLSM calculator. OK cycles bands.

_url_field: url: where the ORIGINAL app comes from, so its author gets credit. Omit it for apps with no upstream (e.g. ones written here).
